name: familiar
description: Opt-in: the Familiar, a command and continuity layer above an autonomous Mate. It turns Captain intent into bounded, provenance-stamped commands (validated drops), supervises Mate/Bosun lifecycle, reads results from a durable mailbox, and keeps continuity across seats and days. It never writes queue.md or tickets, never dispatches, never commits: both its write and shell lanes are hook-enforced positive allow-lists. Deliberately in no preset; most ships need only a Captain and a Mate. Install with --modules familiar.
